solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Outline plan to visit right-wing heartlands

parts.note: CON is the short form of Conservative, the British right-wing party, whose heartlands are its safe seats
a tour is a planned round of visits

explanation.surface: A strategist sketches a campaign trip through Conservative strongholds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outline plan' wants to be the definition, but 'plan to visit' is the tour; the definition is just 'Outline'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the shape or profile line of something, as on a map's height lines.

clue.text: Fitting giving fair consideration to vehicle users

parts.note: courtesy is consideration shown to others, here to road users
fair and light both describe pale colouring

explanation.surface: Something that treats motorists fairly and considerately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fitting' is a noun here, a fixture in a car, not the adjective 'suitable'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the small interior lamp in a car that comes on when a door opens is a fixture or fitting.

clue.text: Unable to help Donna & co, regrettably

indicators.note: regrettably suggests things gone wrong, so the letters of Donna and co are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone apologises that they cannot assist Donna and her friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a colloquial refusal meaning it cannot be done, said by someone unable to help.

clue.text: Proprietor not wholly in state of depression

indicators.note: not wholly means the word for a depressing state loses a letter, here its first

parts.note: a downer is a depressing experience or low mood

explanation.surface: A business owner is partly depressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not wholly' drops the D from DOWNER.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a proprietor is the person who possesses a property or business.

clue.text: Not good-natured; I was wrecked

indicators.note: wrecked means the letters of natured and I are smashed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to a bad temper and having been drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'good-natured' is split: 'Not good' is the definition and 'natured' is the fodder. 'was' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something spoiled or brought to ruin is in a bad state, no longer any use.

clue.text: Is coming over to catch affected fish

indicators.note: to catch means the turned word grips the next piece inside it
coming over means the word Is is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: camp means theatrically affected or exaggerated

explanation.surface: An angler arrives to land a showy fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' means theatrical, not moved; 'coming over' turns the word Is round and 'to catch' makes it grip that synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose usage: the dish of breaded langoustine tails, served as seafood, counted as fish.

clue.text: Screen tax

definitions.meaning: to sieve or filter, as a screen does
to tax or overstretch, as with resources

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to sift liquid through a mesh, and to stretch something to its limit.

clue.text: Related to waiter

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means accompanying or connected with
an ... waits on people, as a waiter does

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: accompanying something as a consequence, and a person who serves.

clue.text: See 10
Starts university and is able to take back control, which is more unexpected

indicators.note: Starts means only the opening letter of university is used

parts.note: 'n' is the shortened form of and, as in rock 'n' roll
can means is able to

indicators.note: take back means the word for control is read in reverse

parts.note: to rein is to control, as with a horse

explanation.surface: A student begins university and manages to regain command, surprisingly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take back' turns REIN into NIER; 'which is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something stranger or more eerie than expected, comparative form.

clue.text: Relationship, note, with one in Germany

parts.note: ti is a note of the sol-fa scale
ein is German for one

explanation.surface: A romance, a message, and a German partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a connection or link between two things, such as a film and a book.

clue.text: Telephone men strike; it unfortunately puts a stop to procrastination!

definitions.note: a proverb urging action, standing for what puts a stop to delay

indicators.note: unfortunately signals things gone awry, so the letters of telephone men strike and it are scrambled

explanation.surface: A phone engineers' walkout regrettably stops people putting things off.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description of what the proverb does rather than a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverb: the saying urges doing a task now rather than delaying it.

clue.text: Benjamin Britten oratorio starring Luciano Pavarotti

indicators.note: starring here means featuring within, so the letters sit inside Britten oratorio

explanation.surface: A Britten choral work features the great Italian opera singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Pavarotti was a celebrated Italian operatic singer of the high male voice.

clue.text: A business that indicated vocal co-operation

indicators.note: vocal means the words are spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: a line is a line of business, and meant is indicated: spoken, a line meant

explanation.surface: A company once signalled spoken teamwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that' is a link between 'A business' and 'indicated'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: agreement or co-operation between groups, as in political cooperation.

clue.text: Bear to push hard on the motorway

definitions.meaning: to bear a burden is to take it on one's back
to barge forward with the upper arm
the hard strip at the motorway's edge for emergency stops

explanation.definitionFit: Three senses: to take on responsibility, to barge, and the hard verge of a British motorway.

clue.text: Official goes up with son in support of Ray

indicators.note: in means the letter for son goes inside the turned word
in a down clue goes up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: official figures are the real ones, so real stands for official
a beam is a supporting timber

explanation.surface: A referee climbs with his boy, backing a man called Ray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes up' turns REAL into LAER; S goes inside to make LASER. 'with' and 'of' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a narrow intense shaft of light from an optical device.

clue.text: Aggressive person from suburban Tamworth

indicators.note: from means the letters are taken out of suburban Tamworth

explanation.surface: A thug comes from a Midlands town's outskirts.
explanation.definitionFit: Figurative: a small but combative fighter, after the feisty little chicken breed.

clue.text: Clear initial course is to study battle

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
the Somme was a First World War battle

explanation.surface: A cadet's first lesson is to examine a battle.
explanation.walkthrough: The Somme is a river in France, site of a great 1916 battle. 'is to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a clear soup, typically served as a starter at dinner.

clue.text: Poet worked tirelessly else will be forgotten

indicators.note: worked means the letters are rearranged, once those of else are set aside

parts.note: these letters are the ones to be taken out of the pool

explanation.surface: A writer toiled without rest, or else be forgotten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will be forgotten' says the letters of ELSE leave TIRELESSLY; 'worked' shuffles the rest, TIRSLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: one who writes lyrics or lyric verse, a kind of poet.

clue.text: Stream game, holding a number by restraint

indicators.note: holding means the abbreviation for the game wraps round the number

parts.note: RU is rugby union
IV is four in Roman numerals
a let is a hindrance, as in without let or hindrance

explanation.surface: A match fixes a figure through constraint.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a small brook or watercourse.

clue.text: Swirling refrain whose content begins to rouse, then impress

indicators.note: whose content means the following letters fill the middle of the word for refrain

parts.note: a vocal is the sung part of a song, a refrain

indicators.note: begins to means just the opening letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: A chorus stirs the crowd, then wows them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refrain' looks like a verb meaning hold back, but it is a sung part; 'whose content' puts the three initials from 'begins to' inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: whirling like an eddy or whirlpool.

clue.text: Halfway to the highest point, friend is on trend

indicators.note: Halfway to means the word for the peak loses its second half

parts.note: a climax is the highest point
mate is a friend

explanation.surface: Part-way up the summit, a pal stays fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the prevailing mood or tendency, as in the political climate.

clue.text: Influences the military

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: powers that exert pressure, and the armed services.

clue.text: Prison heads want Tory politician to service 50% of vehicles

parts.note: Michael Gove is a Conservative politician
RN is the Royal Navy, an armed service

indicators.note: 50% of means the word for vehicles keeps only half, losing its front half

parts.note: motors are cars

explanation.surface: Jail chiefs want a Tory to repair half the fleet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'want' and 'to' are links; the back half of MOTORS gives ORS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the officials in charge of a jail are its wardens, the senior staff.

clue.text: Rise up when wine overwhelms one

indicators.note: overwhelms means the word for wine engulfs the letter for one

parts.note: hock is German white wine
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A drinker's spirits soar when wine gets the better of them.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal verb: to jerk or yank sharply upwards, as an aircraft climbing steeply.

clue.text: Feeling that auditor's in deserted haunt

indicators.note: in means the hearing organ goes inside the remaining letters
deserted means emptied, so haunt keeps only its outside letters

parts.note: an auditor is a listener, so the organ of hearing; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: An accountant senses something in an abandoned spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'auditor' suggests an accountant, but it is just a listener.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: emotion or sentiment, as in having a change of heart.

clue.text: Fabric before all else that unskilled ladies like embroidering

indicators.note: before all else means the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A cloth that amateur needlewomen love to stitch first.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a fine netted silk or nylon material, used for veils and tutus.

clue.text: Soldier, 15, gets confused in bed

indicators.note: in means the jumbled letters sit inside the word for bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: gets confused means the letters of the answer at 15 are mixed up

parts.note: 15-across gives the small fighting bird

explanation.surface: A soldier gets muddled in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: '15' points to the answer at 15-across, which 'gets confused' scrambles and 'in' places within the small bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a fighter, one taking part in combat.

clue.text: Puzzles over bits that are left

definitions.meaning: the remaining parts after something is cut off

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: baffles someone, and remnants such as tree remains after felling.

clue.text: Draconian limit

definitions.meaning: the furthest point or end of a range

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: severe or harsh, and the very edge or end point.
